answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to maintain a living pulse of unique computational work that is continuously cross-checked against a shared atlas of prior attestations. Each new claim must light a lantern of fresh, non-replicable evidence that peers can independently verify before it is allowed to influence the ledger. Duplicate or synthetic identities fail because they cannot sustain the required pulse without colliding with the atlas or extinguishing their lantern under scrutiny.
